name: Rell
notes: Rell opens Mounted and casts Magnet Storm (R) immediately at t=0 for its pull and its 8-tick, 2-second damage-over-time field, since its 80-120 s cooldown means it is realistically only cast once in a short fight.

Ferromancy is modeled as a single ability slot with one shared 10 s cooldown regardless of form: whenever it comes off cooldown Rell casts whichever form is currently available, alternating Crash Down (dismount) and Mount Up (mount).

Crash Down's landing damage is dealt as soon as the cast resolves (the engine treats a cast time as instant plus the standard 0.25 s post-cast attack lockout, so the dash/cast time itself is not separately modeled) and applies a Break the Mold stack; its subsequent 320-unit slide is not modeled as a second hit on the already-landed-upon, stationary dummy.

Mount Up arms Rell's next basic attack: that attack's cast time is fixed at 0.2 s (overriding the normal windup) and, once it lands, deals Mount Up's bonus magic damage and resets the following attack to normal timing; if the 3.5 s arming window lapses before an attack fires the arm is simply dropped.

Shattering Strike (Q) is cast on cooldown for its flat magic damage and applies a Break the Mold stack; its extra 0.35 s post-cast lockout beyond the engine's standard 0.25 s attack lockout is not separately modeled, matching how the engine treats ability cast times elsewhere.

Full Tilt (E) has no ally to target in a solo dummy fight; with no valid ally it is read as self-cast, which the wiki says still arms Rell's next basic attack or Shattering Strike with the max-health explosion. Since that explosion's whole purpose is to land on an enemy, it is modeled as landing on whichever enemy (the dummy) the qualifying attack or Q actually hits, and E is cast on cooldown to keep it armed.

Full Tilt's percent-max-health explosion damage uses the target's maximum health (not current) per the tooltip, scaling with a flat 3%-per-100-AP bonus on top of the by-rank base percent; its separate monster/structure damage cap does not apply against a champion-type dummy and is not modeled.

Break the Mold's target debuff (3% armor/MR reduction per stack, up to 5 stacks for 15%) is approximated with the engine's single flat armor/MR shred slot: it is switched on only once Rell has landed enough hits to reach the 5-stack cap, and refreshed on every later hit. The wiki's separate per-level flat-minimum-reduction floor is not modeled because the driver has no access to the target's actual armor/MR values.

Break the Mold's on-hit bonus magic damage uses Rell's own total armor and magic resistance from the item build; while Dismounted its +15% bonus armor/MR passive is approximated as +15% of that total (rather than of the bonus-only portion, since base/bonus splits for resistances are not exposed to the driver). Rell's own bonus resistances gained from stolen enemy resistances are not modeled since they only affect survivability, not damage dealt.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here binds inside a short fight at level 16.
